prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: single production-ready fantasy game BOTTOM NAVIGATION BACKPLATE texture, not a full screen.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND PROPORTION REFERENCE ONLY. Study the black horizontal strip behind the four circular bottom menu buttons in its lower edge. Ignore all red hand-drawn annotations.
Primary request: create only that dark horizontal menu backing with its subtle charcoal-black satin gradient, warm thin antique-brass horizontal trim and three decorative vertical separators, combined into ONE raster asset. The four buttons, their circular medallions, icons and Korean labels will be separate live UI objects: do NOT include any buttons, medallions, circular borders, icons or letters in this background.
Composition: a very wide shallow band, 12:1 visible aspect ratio, centered across a wide canvas with transparent empty space above and below. Long strip nearly spans the canvas horizontally. Four equal reserved blank menu areas with centers at 16%,39%,61%,84% of width; short decorative gold vertical separators halfway between those areas, at 27%,50%,73%. Separators have slender tapered stems and tiny spearhead finials at top and bottom, located within bottom half of strip. Elegant 1-2 screen-pixel equivalent lines, not straight thick flat UI strokes. The panel ends gently fade into true transparency horizontally, no hard rectangular side edge.
Style: restrained medieval demon heraldry, clean polished 2D illustrated UI, smooth shading, muted antique brass, charcoal and near-black gradient. One thin continuous bronze-gold trim along top edge, a subtler bottom rim, natural soft shading and fine highlight, black center. Keep surface very dark and very understated, readable as background for cream text. Metal border and black background must be rendered together; do not separate.
No screen background, no castle, no scenery, no red marks, no text, no icons, no skull, no circles, no extra ornaments, no grain/no speckles, no pixel art, no big gold frame. Genuine alpha exterior and smoothly fading ends. Visible band centered in canvas, full width uncropped.
usage: Single fused gradient background and decorative border/separator texture for all four bottom navigation tabs. Existing procedural lines disabled.
